citation: González-Hermosillo G JA, Galarza EJ, Fermín OV, González JMN, Tostado LMFÁ, Lozano MAE, et al. Exaggerated blood pressure elevation in response to orthostatic challenge, a post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC) after hospitalization. Auton Neurosci. 2023;247:103094.
licence: Elsevier, all rights reserved; COVID-19 resource-centre re-use grant (PMC)
protocol: Passive head-up tilt test: 30 min supine rest, baseline in the last 5 min; then tilt to 70 degrees for 25 min; then supine recovery.
population: Healthy controls n=32 (historical asymptomatic comparison group; age 47.7 +/- 10.7 y, BMI 26.3 +/- 3.2, 16 women), printed beside the PASC group (n=23) in Table 1; PASC patients excluded here.
note: Blood pressure is mean +/- SD, but supine heart rate in Table 1 is median (IQR), so the HR cannot be pooled as a mean. Controls are historical, and the licence is publisher-specific (COVID-19 reuse grant), not Creative Commons.
